description:
IB III, 53. Fragment of a letter from Peraḥyā Yijū to Abu ʾl-Fakhr Ibn al-Amshāṭī. Written in al-Maḥalla, ca. 1161-72.

"Peraḥyā extends to him wishes that he celebrate the coming Passover together with his son and brother's son (the boy was presumably orphaned from his father), and so for many years to come. Presumably, Abu ʾl-Fakhr's other children, whom Peraḥyā had blessed with life in [PGPID 4741], line 3 and margin top, did not survive. Alternatively, III, 53, was written before the birth of the other children. 
[...]The letter is addressed to Abu ʾl-Fakhr's shop in the Square of the Perfumers of Fustat." (Goitein & Friedman, India Book, p. 780)
